caseName: Eastern Publishing & Advertising, Inc. v. Chesapeake Publishing & Advertising, Inc.
caseNameFull: Eastern Publishing & Advertising, Inc., t/a Armed Forces News v. Chesapeake Publishing & Advertising, Inc., t/a The Military News

opinions.text: C. A. 4th Cir. Certiorari granted, judgment vacated, and case remanded for further consideration in light of H. J. Inc. v. Northwestern Bell Telephone Co., ante, p. 229. The Chief Justice, Justice White, Justice Stevens, and Justice O’Connor would deny certiorari.
